sql_query:
WITH order_totals AS (
  SELECT
    LEFT(op.order_id, 10) AS order_id,
    ABS(SUM(op.payment_value))::numeric AS order_price
  FROM order_payments op
  GROUP BY LEFT(op.order_id, 10)
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS order_count,
  ABS(SUM(order_price))::numeric AS total_revenue,
  ABS(AVG(order_price))::numeric AS average_order_price,
  ABS(
    (SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY order_price) FROM order_totals)
  )::numeric AS median_order_price,
  ABS(MIN(order_price))::numeric AS minimum_order_price,
  ABS(MAX(order_price))::numeric AS maximum_order_price,
  ABS(STDDEV_POP(order_price))::numeric AS stddev_order_price
FROM order_totals;
